name: MaximumSoundPressureDecibelsMeasure
definition: A maximum difference between the actual pressure at any point in the field of a sound wave at any instant and the average pressure at that point detected by remote ground sensor strings measured in decibels.

name: MaximumStorageCapacityValue

name: MaximumSubstanceReleaseHeightMeasure

name: WeightMeasureAugmentationPoint
definition: An augmentation point for type usmtf:WeightMeasureType

name: WeightShortTonsTenthsMeasure
definition: A weight in short tons measured to the nearest tenth.

name: WeightUnitCode
definition: A unit of weight measurement.

name: WeightUnitHKgKLbCode
definition: A unit of weight expressed in hundreds of kilograms or thousands of pounds.

name: WeightUnitKilogramsPoundsCode
definition: A unit of weight expressed in kilograms or pounds.

name: WeightValue
definition: A quantity or amount of heaviness of an object, in the range 0 through 99999 or any combination of four or fewer digits and a significant decimal point (pt). There is a 5-character maximum (max).

name: WetBulbGlobeTempIndexValue
definition: An index that is derived by combining three temperature readings (wet bulb, dry bulb and black globe).

name: WideFieldOfViewKilometersMeasure
definition: A wide field of view distance for Forward Looking Infrared (FLIR) measured in kilometers.

name: WideFieldOfViewNauticalMilesMeasure
definition: A wide field of view distance for Forward Looking Infrared Radar (FLIR) in nautical miles.

name: WidebandUserCode
definition: A numerical code that indicates the user of a radio frequency in the wideband spectrum.

name: Width0To99999Value
definition: A width in the range 0 through 99999 or any combination of four or fewer digits and a significant decimal point (pt). There is a 5-character maximum (max).

name: Width0To999Value
definition: A width of an item, in the range 0 through 999.

name: Width1To999.9FeetMetersMeasure
definition: A linear measurement of an object at its widest point.

name: Width1To999.9FeetMetersMeasureAugmentationPoint
definition: An augmentation point for type usmtf:Width1To999.9FeetMetersMeasureType

name: Width1To999.9Value
definition: A width, in feet or meters, in the range 1 through 999.9.

name: Width1To99999Value
definition: A width in the range 1 through 9999.

name: WidthCentimetersMeasure
definition: A width of an object or area, measured in centimeters.

name: WidthFeetMeasure
definition: A linear extent of an area or thing measured to increments of 12 inches or 30.48 centimeters from side to side.

name: WidthMeasureAugmentationPoint
definition: An augmentation point for type usmtf:WidthMeasureType

name: WidthMeasureMeasure
definition: A linear distance from side to side of a target, object, or area.

name: WidthMetersMeasure
definition: A measurement of an object taken at right angles to the length.

name: WidthTenthsOfFeetMeasure
definition: A measured extent from side to side of a thing, object, or space in tenths of feet.

name: WidthTenthsOfMetersMeasure
definition: A linear width of anything as measured from side to side in tenths of a meter.

name: WindDirectionDegreesMeasure
definition: A count of angular units of 360 parts of a complete circle representing wind direction. data item values consist of the integers 000 through 360 and decimal point values ranging from 0.1 to 359.9, incremented by .1.

name: WindDirectionDegreesRelativeTrueNorthMeasure
definition: A direction from which the wind is blowing (in relation to true north).

name: WindDirectionMilsMeasure
definition: A count of angular units subtended by 1/6400 circumference representing wind direction.

name: WindDirectionQualifierCode
definition: A status of wind in a null or non-stable mode.

name: WindSpeed0To999KnotsMeasure
definition: A mean sustained wind speed in knots.

name: WindSpeedAugmentationPoint
definition: An augmentation point for type usmtf:WindSpeedType

name: WindSpeedKnotsAugmentationPoint
definition: An augmentation point for type usmtf:WindSpeedKnotsType

name: WindSpeedKnotsMeasure
definition: An observed or detected rate of motion of the wind in knots.

name: WindSpeedKnotsValue
definition: A wind speed in knots, in the range 0 through 9999 or in the range 0.1 through 99.9.

name: WindSpeedMeasure
definition: A magnitude of the average wind speed in km/h or knots.

name: WindSpeedMeasurement
definition: A magnitude of speed measured in KPH, MPH, KTS, or MPS.

name: WindSpeedMeasurementAugmentationPoint
definition: An augmentation point for type usmtf:WindSpeedMeasurementType

name: WindSpeedUnspecifiedValue
definition: A numerical representation of wind speed.

name: WindSpeedValue
definition: A wind speed, in the range 0 through 999.

name: WindVariabilityCode
definition: An indicator defining a variable direction of a downwind.

name: WindowRadioFrequencyMeasure
definition: A frequency that has been rounded to a whole frequency based on calculations provided in Repository of USMTF Program Items Document, item 286. The first element is a number representing the Frequency, in values from 0 to 99999999999 (0 to 10 decimal places allowed). The second element is the Radio Frequency Unit of Measurement, with a choice of GHZ for Gigahertz, HZ for Hertz, KHZ for Kilohertz, or MHz for Megahertz.

name: WindowSizeMultiplierValue
definition: A correlation window size multiplier to stretch or reduce the window size.

name: WindspeedUnitCode
definition: A unit of wind speed measurement expressed in kilometers per hour or knots.

name: WorkUnitCode
definition: A code for the work unit code/standard reference designator.

name: WorksheetDetectionActuationBProbabilityPercent
definition: A probability of detection or actuation of a mine (B) from worksheet.

name: WorksheetID
definition: An identifier of the diplomatic clearance worksheet.

name: WorksheetMineIdentificationNumberCode
definition: A worksheet mine identification number that identifies the mine to which the data applies.

name: WorksheetName
definition: A name uniquely identifying the worksheet.

name: WorksheetSearchSweepWidthYardsAMeasure
definition: A search and or sweep width in yards (A) from worksheet.

name: WorksheetVersionText
definition: A hidden worksheet version.

name: WorldAreaNumberID
definition: A numeric identifier of the world area (formerly the world aeronautical chart number) in which a designated place, installation or area is located.

name: WorldPortIndexNumeric
definition: A five digit number as shown in the World Port Index publication. For further U.S. implementation guidance, see Repository of USMTF Program Items Document, item 305.

name: XAxisGridReferenceValue
definition: A character set composing the horizontal X-axis of the grid reference.

name: XREFText
definition: An appropriate cross reference (XREF) code associated with the CST channel name.

name: YAxisGridReferenceValue
definition: A character set composing the vertical Y-axis of the grid reference.

name: Year2DigitDate
definition: A 2-digit year period of either 365 or 366 days of a century as defined by the Gregorian calendar.

name: YearDate
definition: A year period of either 365 or 366 days of a century as defined by the Gregorian calendar.

name: YearDesignatorNumeric
definition: A year in which an event occurred during the immediately preceding ten year period.

name: YearDesignatorValue
definition: A year in which an event occurred during the immediately preceding ten year period.

name: YearJulianDay
definition: A year and Julian day.

name: YearJulianDayAugmentationPoint
definition: An augmentation point for type usmtf:YearJulianDayType

name: YearMonth
definition: A year and month of an event, publication, or document.

name: YearMonthAugmentationPoint
definition: An augmentation point for type usmtf:YearMonthType

name: YearMonthDayDate
definition: A date which specifies a given event.

name: YearPublishedDate
definition: A 4-digit year published.

name: ZIPAPONumeric
definition: A Zone Improvement Plan (ZIP) or Army Post Office (APO) designation.

name: Zone1RadiusValue
definition: A count of units of length of an unspecified unit of measurement representing the radius of Zone 1.

name: ZoneAngleDegreesMeasure
definition: An angle on either side of an axis or center bearing that describes a zone the shape of a piece of pie.

name: ZoneIdentificationText
definition: A name or number designating a specific zone for the purpose of identifying a crossover zone.

name: ZoneOfFireResponsibilityText
definition: A designator of an area within which a fire unit is responsible to deliver or is prepared to deliver fire support.

name: ZoneWeaponControlStatusCode
definition: A current status for weapons control in the identified engagement zone.

name: ZuluDateTime
definition: A point in time expressed as Date-Time Group, Zulu.
